name: Set on Fire
prompt: Intense roaring flames engulf the person's whole body from head to toe, bright orange fire licking up the arms, torso and legs with sparks and embers flying, strong heat haze and firelight glowing on the surroundings, cinematic VFX shot, the person stays in the same place and the camera, lighting and background match the original footage
negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted face, extra limbs, warped body, flickering, watermark, text, subtitles, cartoon, deformed hands
